notes.title: EVERYTHING update
notes.content:
Introducing [b]EVERYTHING [/b]mode - a new game mode consisting of all the other modes (CTF, Battle Royale, King of the Hill, Snake Hunter and Deathmatch) at the same time! Your team will earn points from capturing flags, killing opposing players, standing in the scoring zone, and damaging/killing AI snakes.

As with the rest of the game, the rules for [b]EVERYTHING[/b] mode arehighly customizable - you can enable or disable certain modes and alter the points scored for various events.

This update also includes a number of minor improvements including a larger font size for team scores and smaller replay files.
